title: Merge-ES-Excluded-from-Calculation-to-W1
summary: Merges the Spanish Excluded from Calculation functionality into W1, according to the title. Customer, vendor, ledger entry and General Ledger Setup tables change across many localization layers. ES-specific copies of My Customer and Standard Statement are removed.
key_points: Title says the ES Excluded from Calculation functionality is merged into W1
Customer, Vendor, ledger entry, detailed ledger entry and General Ledger Setup tables change across many country layers
ES-layer My Customer table and Standard Statement report files are removed
Statement reports in several layers and Currency tables in ES and NA are adjusted
The PR description gives no details of the behaviour
